research: Joline Fan, MD, MS, is an Assistant Professor at UCSF in the Departments of Neurology (Division of Epilepsy) and Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences. Her research focuses on developing innovative neurostimulation technologies for neuropsychiatric disorders and exploring the complex relationship between sleep and epilepsy through multimodal neuroimaging. As an epileptologist, Dr. Fan specializes in invasive recording methods, including intracranial responsive neurostimulation and stimulation mapping. She is also investigating personalized, non-invasive, low-intensity focused ultrasound methods for treating neuropsychiatric disorders like depression and epilepsy.
